name: branding-slanted-stretched-project-send-wordmark-on-lime
title: Heavy black 'PROJECT SEND' set in a stretched, skewed perspective on flat lime green
whatItIs: A flat light lime field with a black wordmark in two lines, 'PROJECT' large and 'SEND' below, where the letters are stretched and skewed as if seen in perspective, with D much larger than the others and slightly rotated.
whatItMeans: Energetic and urgent; warped scale makes the word feel like it is being thrown forward.
techniques: Stack two lines with tight spacing.
Use black on one bright colour.

vocabulary.definition: Type distorted as if viewed at an angle.
Letters of very different sizes in one word.
A name set on two lines.
